newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Stelux to sell HK$300 mln component unit.
newsitem.headline: Stelux to sell HK$300 mln component unit.

text.p: Stelux Holdings International Ltd said on Wednesday it would sell its watch component division to Winfaith Holdings Ltd, a firm controlled by Stelux's executive director Ng Hung Kaing, for a total HK$300 million.
Stelux said it has agreed to sell to Winfaith its entire 100 percent stake in Dugale Holdings Ltd, a company which would hold the group's watch component division after a reorganisation.
The division manufactures watch bracelets, cases and dials for the retail watch unit of the group. The division had a net asset value of HK$122.48 million as at March 31, 1996.

"The agreement represents an opportunity to the group to dispose of its watch compements manufacturing business at a profit of approximately HK$60 million while retaining the most profitable operations," Stelux managing director Joseph Wong said in the statement.
